newsitem.title: USA: NYSE says Kmart declines comment on activity.
newsitem.headline: NYSE says Kmart declines comment on activity.

text.p: The New York Stock Exchange said Tuesday that Kmart Corp declined comment after the Exchange contacted the company amid heavy trading and a takover speculation.
The Exchange said it asked the company to issue a public statement explaining the activity, but the company said its policy is not to comment on unusual market activity or rumors.
Kmart rose as much as 1-3/8 to 11 Tuesday afternoon on speculation that the company is in takeover talks with Kohlberg Kravis Roberts & Co.
